scientific_integrity: The result concerns the leading asymptotic errors for each fixed positive continuous boundary sampling density, with a local uniform-in-angle shape expansion. No finite-sample optimality, global stability, or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Dimension at least three and fixed smooth radial perturbations only
The coefficient is local to the sphere, with remainder dependent on the perturbation
Published planar-ellipse minimax results are prior work
Unindexed historical perturbation literature may overlap; no independent audit performed
title: Sharp spherical-harmonic cost of sharing random-polytope sampling laws
